# https://anantasutra.com

## About
AnantaSutra (अनन्तसूत्र) — from the Sanskrit Ananta (infinite) and Sutra (thread/wisdom) — is a constellation of ventures spanning AI automation, creative marketing, technology, spirituality, and human potential. Founded by Bhavya Duneja, based in Delhi, India.

## Services

### AI Automation & Intelligence
- Voice Calling Agents: Intelligent conversational AI starting at ₹6/minute
- Recruiter AI: Automated talent sourcing at ₹2/lead
- AI Video Generators: AI-powered video creation for marketing and real estate
- Social Media Automation: Smart scheduling, content generation, engagement optimization
- Gmail Automation: Intelligent email workflows
- AI Marketing Tools: Data-driven campaign optimization and audience targeting

### Creative & Marketing Agency
- Professional Shooting: Photo and video production
- Content Creation: Design and copywriting
- Social Media Management: All platforms
- Brand Strategy: Growth-focused planning
- Performance Marketing: ROI-driven campaigns
- Creative Direction: Unique brand identity

### Website Building & Search Optimization
- Website Development: Modern, responsive, high-performance websites built with Next.js
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization): On-page, technical, and off-page SEO to rank on Google
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization): Structured data and content optimization to appear in AI-powered answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): Schema markup, llms.txt, and entity optimization so AI platforms cite and recommend your business
- Analytics & Tracking: Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Facebook Pixel setup
- Domain & Hosting: End-to-end domain registration, DNS, and Vercel/cloud hosting setup
